name: Ripio wMXN
oneLiner: WMXN is Ripio's Mexican-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Mexican-peso fiat cash deposited in a Mexican bank account, backing Ripio wMXN one-to-one against the Mexican peso per Ripio's wFIAT token certification
pegMechanism: Issuer-controlled wFIAT token: the Ripio affiliate mints WMXN against local Mexican-peso reserves and burns supply as needed, holding 1 WMXN = 1 MXN through on/off-ramp convertibility on Ripio and other VASP platforms plus DEX arbitrage; holders have no contractual on-chain redemption right

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At fixed 2026-07-15 blocks Ethereum 25534997, Base 48646186, Worldchain 32373046, BSC 110049753, Polygon 90251163, and Gnosis 47208124, every tracked WMXN proxy resolved to 0x425abec6165c83d30fcf81ec66635c6c7ee2bbf7 and returned paused() = false. On each route, 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b held both PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. Ethereum, Base, and Worldchain run the verified pausable LatamStable variant, so that EOA can halt all ERC-20 updates; BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis run the verified compliance variant, which additionally exposes blockUser, unblockUser, and setEnforceBlocklist and rejects a blocked sender or receiver in _update when enforcement is enabled. This is an asset-wide direct freeze conclusion from all six tracked routes, but address-specific blocklisting is only asserted for BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. The V9 transfer review is resolved by the direct pause/blocklist mechanisms, not a permissioning-adapter inference. Ripio's public GitHub organization did not expose a wFIAT/LatamStable Solidity repository, and Archive.org returned no snapshot for the reviewed English wFIAT page; deployed explorer source and fixed RPC evidence remain sufficient. The issuer's March 2026 collateral certification was reviewed as transparency evidence, not as access-control proof.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WMXN is natively issuer-minted by Ripio on all six tracked chains (same contract address everywhere; MINTER_ROLE held by the issuer EOA 0x466c02e2 plus Ripio's rate-limited minter contracts). Cross-chain transfers use Ripio's own verified burn-mint bridge (0x465e6423 depositForBridge/burnFrom -> fulfillBridgeMint -> LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb0 mintTo, 100,000 WMXN/day cap per chain, BRIDGE_OPERATOR EOAs 0x5ca3f8ee/0xbc924f70, admins issuer EOA + 4/7 Safe 0x2b839174), re-verified on-chain 2026-07-20. No third-party or externally validated bridge holds mint rights on any tracked deployment.

No third-party bridge holds mint rights.

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 518,689 outstanding wMXN across six chains and MXN937,364.13 of collateral to a Mexican bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Mexican pesos at a financial institution in Mexico. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wMXN collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Mexican financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The March 31, 2026 certification by Pablo Eduardo Soto (Certified Public Accountant, Professional Council of Economic Sciences of CABA) reconciled 518,689 outstanding wMXN to MXN 937,364.13 on a Mexican bank statement but is expressly not an audit or review — it is an agreed-procedures certification on client-supplied documents, and it is the first wMXN attestation published. The bank is not named; account segregation, insolvency protections, and rehypothecation terms are undisclosed, and the certified collateral-to-token surplus (~1.81x) is unexplained in the document.
